## Appearance

Adrian Treleaven possesses a tall, broad-shouldered frame accompanied by dense brown hair and a sharp nose and chin. His countenance features expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes as well as a distinct pallor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001)_

## History

Born to the daughter of schoolmaster [John Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md), Adrian Treleaven published short stories in magazines but struggled to find the time to write a full book. Upon arriving in the area, he moved into lodgings at the Vane house, where he was immediately struck by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's beauty. Captain Saul, recognizing Adrian as Damaris Tremayne's grandson, lent him his treasured life-book, inspiring Adrian to spend the summer at the lighthouse writing a novel based on Saul's life story. Though deeply in love with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), Adrian initially left without confessing his feelings, relying on [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to write to him with news of her. He later returned to visit while awaiting the publication of his book, *The Life Book*, and declared his love to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) in the garden before delivering their finished book to Captain Saul.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), +29 more_

## Quotes

> "The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us. And our labor will commence immediately."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)

> "however, it is essentially finished. The final line was composed by me earlier today. Should I manage to locate a publisher, its release will likely occur during the upcoming summer or autumn."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P19](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0019)

> "He has to experience solitude frequently, however. This evening, he resembled a prophet somewhat—his words sounded like those of a person granted a special message. In any case, I need to depart now as well."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P26](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0026)

> "Yes,—he is lacking in his intellect, or some such thing, is he not? However, she mentioned nothing concerning Mrs. Vane, so I assumed she would be the typical bustling rural homemaker who accommodates guests to make a decent living."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030)

> "Oh, I will not pay attention to him. I do not think I will spend much time inside the dwelling anyway, save to eat. Even so, what a pity the whole situation is! She must have a difficult existence."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P32](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0032)

### [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--lorna-vane.md)

Adrian Treleaven was immediately struck by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's striking beauty upon his arrival in the area, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) cared for him in the past. After spending a summer enjoying coastal outings together, the two eventually declared their deep love for one another in the garden and received a heartfelt blessing from Captain Saul.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acts as a supportive friend and confidante to Adrian Treleaven. She originally introduced him to the local area, supported his work on Captain Saul's life story, listened sympathetically when he secretly agonized over his love for [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), and promised to keep him updated on [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) after he left.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +10 more_

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--uncle-saul.md)

Adrian Treleaven formed a close bond with Captain Saul, who realized Adrian was the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) upon their first meeting. Adrian spent a summer writing Captain Saul's life story based on his sea-faring tales and personal life-book, later keeping in touch through correspondence regarding the publication of the completed book.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +14 more_

- Friend of — corresponds with him about his book  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>

### [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--winifred-tolley.md)

Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) maintains a friendship with Adrian Treleaven, liking him despite her tendency to penalize his grandiloquent speech. She originally dropped him off at Nell's house upon his arrival in the area and later approved of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during Adrian's visit.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +6 more_
